rules: Do not truncate, compact, or drop portal packet units.
Use bullet-first concise company introductions in candidate-facing portal packets; avoid long prose company paragraphs.
Raw JD facts excluded from candidate copy by explicit user instruction must be represented in excluded_units with reason starting explicit_user_exclusion.
Do not include generic documents/application boilerplate or obvious conditions when the user explicitly excludes them; preserve them only as excluded_units evidence.
Assign each source unit id exactly once per portal packet.
Refuse URL, email, and direct-apply text in candidate-visible fields.
JobKorea proposalMessage is transient until read back from a proposal flow.
